name: WhatsApp Call
description: Compact WhatsApp call activity: tilted green phone symbol on the left, live orange input/green output waveform on the right, and microphone, End call and camera controls.

settings.title: Refresh
settings.description: Active-call fallback interval. Idle checks: 60 seconds with window events, 15 seconds otherwise; closed apps: 5 minutes.

settings.title: WhatsApp Desktop App
settings.description: Detect calls opened in the WhatsApp macOS app.

settings.title: Diagnostic Activity
settings.description: Show a fake call so you can preview the interface without joining one.

settings.title: Live Waveform
settings.description: Live levels on the right of the compact activity, orange for your already-authorized microphone, green for optional app output. No new microphone permission prompt.

settings.title: Other Participant Audio
settings.description: Capture the call app audio as well. Optional: macOS may request system audio recording permission.

settings.title: Microphone Sensitivity
settings.description: Orange bars only: lower values require louder speech; higher values respond more strongly. Echo-aware local speech detection is used when the input device supports it.
